presets.name: Bare
presets.description: Two optional components off. The style is a paper collage, and with fewer scraps on the face the cut shapes of the head and eyes carry it.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.description: The cheeks are switched off here rather than recolored: the style's only cheek scrap is printed pink, and no color option reaches it.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.description: Paper cut from a black and white page. The drop shadow under each scrap does the work that color usually does, so the layers still read apart.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.description: One color for the face, one for everything behind and on top of it. The head shapes and the cut of the features are all that separates two avatars.

presets.name: Muted
presets.description: The style cuts from saturated stock. This is the same collage in paper that has been sitting in the sun, which suits a page where many of them appear together. The mouth scrap moves with the rest: the style cuts it from four reds, and one of those against a faded face is all you would see.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: Only the face scraps go loud. The hair stays dark so the collage keeps a top and a bottom instead of turning into one bright field.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: The five grounds the style ships are all near-white. These are pale but present, which gives the paper something to sit on.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.summary: Six grounds, loud under the paper.
presets.description: The scraps are mid-toned and each carries a drop shadow, so they hold their edge against a saturated ground.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. The face palette lightens so the collage still separates from the ground, and the hair keeps its dark stock.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient under the paper.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. Both stops stay light, so the shadows under the scraps keep their contrast.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.summary: Hair, brows and cheeks on everyone.
presets.description: All three optional components turned up. The style ships seven haircuts and four brow shapes that most seeds never reach.

presets.name: Close Up
presets.summary: The collage scaled up in the frame.
presets.description: The style leaves a wide margin around the head. This crops in until the paper nearly touches the edge, which is what you want at 24 or 32 pixels.
